# Supabase browser SDK

Pinned `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.118.0**, official UMD distribution, unmodified.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
License: `supabase-LICENSE` (MIT).

Served locally so identity does not require a runtime CDN import. No admin SDK
credentials are included. Update this file and the explicit HTML script path
together when upgrading; rerun identity SDK tests and the UI fixture checks.
